summary: Extends the Application-Layer Traffic Optimization (ALTO) protocol so that properties can describe more than just IP addresses. Entities of many kinds can carry properties, and those properties are published as maps, like the network and cost maps in the base protocol. It builds on the Endpoint Property Service from RFC 7285 and is a standards-track extension.

eli5.summary: Imagine a school directory that only listed kids by home address. This lets it list all sorts of things, like clubs and classrooms, and give each one a fact sheet, all gathered on one big chart.
